abstract: Maintains bollard pull load ratings, mooring structural certifications, and quay berthing dimensions
system_message:
You are the Quayside Infrastructure and Mooring Engineering (ENG) division. Your business responsibilities include maintaining bollard pull load ratings, mooring structural certifications, and quay berthing dimensions across candidate port facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Production harbor environment·Maintains bollard pull load ratings, mooring structural certifications, and quay berthing dimensions（MOOR）
information_points.content:
ENG-MOOR-A6Y：Under the Production harbor environment, Port of Saint-Malo Quayside holds heavy mooring bollard certification with a minimum 100-tonne safe working load rating, and its continuous heavy-duty quay berthing face provides a gross berthing length of 1,200 m.
ENG-MOOR-RTI：Under the Production harbor environment, Port of Ponta Delgada Harbor does not hold heavy mooring bollard certification, while its reinforced berthing face provides a gross berthing length of 1,500 m.
ENG-MOOR-ZTW：Under the Production harbor environment, Dartmouth Royal Dart Basin holds heavy mooring bollard certification for its primary tall ship berths, and its quay provides a gross berthing length of 1,200 m.

information_points.title: Simulation sandbox environment·Maintains bollard pull load ratings, mooring structural certifications, and quay berthing dimensions（DREDGE）
information_points.content:
ENG-DREDGE-NMS：Under the Simulation sandbox environment, Port of Ponta Delgada Harbor does not hold heavy mooring bollard certification, and its quay wall provides a gross berthing length of 1,500 m.
ENG-DREDGE-LA8：Under the Simulation sandbox environment, Dartmouth Royal Dart Basin holds heavy mooring bollard certification, and its quay berthing infrastructure provides a gross berthing length of 1,200 m.
ENG-DREDGE-9FB：Under the Simulation sandbox environment, Port of Saint-Malo Quayside does not hold heavy mooring bollard certification, and its designated regatta berthing wall provides a gross berthing length of 1,500 m.
